summary: Fence person reviewer repairs away from internal agent review requests

replay.detail: The canonical assignment fold ignores repairs only for stored requests explicitly marked agent-review; imported repair history cannot strand or substitute their reviewer.

schema.detail: No accepted wire changes; public parsers and generic append still reject the agent-review request/result shapes.

rules.detail: Repair admission reports agent-review-reassignment-forbidden for an agent-review request. Agent reviewer changes require an authorized new mission revision and fresh request, not in-place repair.

compatibility.detail: Human canonical repair, receipt and first-answer behavior remains unchanged. IS NOT keeps historical human requests without gate_kind eligible for their existing repairs.

recovery.detail: No data migration or recovery is required.
